task_completion.description: The agent opens the Subsurface dive log application and loads the dive log file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Subsurface application window is visible, showing a list of dives or dive sites.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies a dive site that is missing GPS coordinates.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent selects or highlights a dive site (e.g., Sund Rock, Zenobia, or Green Bay) where the GPS/Coordinates fields are empty.

task_completion.description: The agent enters the correct latitude into the site management or edit field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The value '47.39170°N' (or 47.3917) is typed into the latitude input field of the dive site editor.

task_completion.description: The agent enters the correct longitude into the site management or edit field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The value '122.57694°W' (or -122.5769) is typed into the longitude input field of the dive site editor.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the changes made to the dive site coordinates.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks an 'Apply', 'OK', or 'Save' button within the dive site edit dialog.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the dive log file to persist the changes to disk.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks 'File' > 'Save' or a disk icon in the main toolbar.

integrity.description: The agent used the Subsurface GUI to edit the coordinates rather than editing the XML file directly via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Subsurface application interface and text being entered into GUI fields.

integrity.description: The agent did not use a text editor (like nano or gedit) to manually modify the .ssrf file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory does not show text editors open with the dive log source code.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus to find the site management or dive list.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking on dive list items or the 'Dive Site' management tab/menu.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target coordinates are 47.39170°N and 122.57694°W. Note that in some software, West longitude is represented as a negative number (-122.57694). Due to a known issue in the environment setup, multiple sites (Sund Rock, Zenobia, Green Bay) may appear to be missing coordinates; the agent is successful if it updates any site missing coordinates with the specified values and saves the file.
